locator.identity_review: Galaxy Backbone's contact page links its head office (1243, Kur Mohammed Ave, Off Ahmadu Bello Way, Central Business District, Abuja; same address in its FAQ) to goo.gl/maps/uRf2zaRS569wq1Tv9, which resolves to the Google feature 'Galaxy Backbone Limited, National Shared Services Center' (0x104e0bb247a88c71:0x2dc5ae606be5343c); the point is that feature's place coordinate, not the map viewport. The head office is used only because the operator identifies it as the facility: its 14 April 2025 release calls the NSSC 'the organization's ultra-modern corporate headquarters' and records a tour there of 'the Uptime Certified Tier III Data Centre, Security Operations Centre, and Network Operations Centre', and its data-centre page says it operates the NSSC Tier III data centre as its primary data centre in the Federal Capital Territory. PeeringDB's self-reported 'Galaxy Backbone NSSC-Abuja' point (address '70, Kur Mohammed Avenue') lies 190 m to the south-west (pyproj WGS84 geodesic) and is kept as corroboration only. In Esri World Imagery (z18/z19, unknown date) the marker falls on open, partly worked ground inside the block, about 20-40 m from the nearest buildings, and Esri's street map labels Kur Mohammed Ave and Ahmadu Bello Way beside it; the imagery does not identify which building houses the data centre (geometry facts).
